notablePrerequisites:
Brigone does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Wizard Class is level 3.
description:
Activate Brigone by tapping and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Brigone.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Brigone.
Repeat.
